description: Shopping cart with quantity controls, separators between items, and a subtotal.

"use client" import * as React from "react" import { MinusIcon, PlusIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Separator } from "@workspace/ui/components/separator" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const initial = [ { id: "mug", name: "Stoneware mug", price: 18, qty: 2, tone: "from-stone-300 to-stone-500", }, { id: "kettle", name: "Pour-over kettle", price: 46, qty: 1, tone: "from-zinc-400 to-zinc-700", }, ] export default function CartItemsSeparated() { const [items, setItems] = React.useState(initial) const subtotal = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.qty, 0) const update = (id: string, delta: number) => setItems( items.map((item) => item.id === id ? { ...item, qty: Math.max(1, item.qty + delta) } : item ) ) return (
